protocol.cohort: Six assigned selection topic groups and 18 disjoint held subject groups. Each has exact matched MIME alternatives, variant ordinary representation with quotes/signatures/formatting differences, substantive HTML-only or plain-only clause, and changed complete clause. Additional held unsupported controls for opaque style, duplicate body alternatives, malformed markup and attachment-only pairs. Freeze source hashes, expected labels, native MIME positions and required change range before scoring.
protocol.outcomes: Exact hit requires correct directed affected part, at least half of known changed tokens, and at least 0.30 token IoU with the source change. Counts by ordinary group, unsupported status, and exact range. No AI authorship, sender, phishing or verified browser claim.
protocol.qualification: At least 15/18 correct in each positive form, at most one ordinary work group with a discrepancy, all unsupported controls abstain, source-range replay succeeds. Source labels are controlled and cannot estimate real mailbox false alarm rates. Require a separate route proof before adding any app behavior.
protocol.ranking: Normalize case, word punctuation, Unicode entities and transport line breaks. Compare visible reply-body lexical tokens. Require original part mapping, at least 5 changed tokens and 3 non-grammar words in at least one side, substantial common text, and at least one shared three-word anchor beside a proposed span. Exclude tokens that occur intact in the other rendition (e.g. reordered paragraphs), link destinations, empty-alt tracking images, ordinary role-marked quote/signature and narrowly identified trailing opt-out notes. Abstain on active, styled, ambiguous, malformed or unsupported multipart/content.
protocol.scope: One uploaded EML with the selected plain body and exactly one HTML sibling in the same direct multipart/alternative group. Either a root alternative or the first body child of multipart/mixed with only explicit attachments outside it. Accept conservative bounded semantic HTML, no rendering or external resources. Explicit quoted/signature text and URLs excluded.
